projects.title: End-to-End Text Classification Pipeline
projects.description: Build a complete NLP pipeline that fine-tunes a BERT-based model on a custom dataset. Include data preprocessing, training with HuggingFace Transformers, evaluation metrics (F1, precision, recall), and a FastAPI inference endpoint. Deploy to GitHub with a reproducible training script.

projects.title: Real-Time Feature Store with Redis
projects.description: Design and implement a feature store that serves ML features at low latency. Ingest raw events, compute features with Pandas, store in Redis, and expose a REST API for model serving. Include TTL-based cache invalidation and a monitoring dashboard.

projects.title: Model Monitoring Dashboard
projects.description: Build a drift detection and model monitoring system. Track prediction distributions over time, detect data drift using statistical tests (KS test, PSI), and visualise degradation with Streamlit. Trigger alerts when drift exceeds a threshold.

projects.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Chatbot
projects.description: Build a RAG system over a document corpus. Use LangChain, FAISS for vector retrieval, and an LLM for answer generation. Add citation of source documents, streaming responses, and a Streamlit UI. Evaluate with RAGAS.

projects.title: LLM Evaluation Framework
projects.description: Design and implement an automated evaluation suite for LLM outputs. Cover faithfulness, relevancy, and hallucination detection using RAGAS. Build a CI pipeline that runs evals on every prompt change and blocks regressions.

projects.title: Agentic Tool-Use System
projects.description: Build a LangChain ReAct agent with at least 3 custom tools: web search, code execution, and a database lookup. Implement conversation memory, tool-call logging with Langfuse, and a FastAPI endpoint that streams the agent's reasoning steps.

projects.title: A/B Test Analysis Toolkit
projects.description: Implement a rigorous A/B testing framework with power analysis, sequential testing (SPRT), and bootstrap confidence intervals. Build a report generator that auto-interprets results and flags common pitfalls (peeking, multiple comparisons).

projects.title: Churn Prediction with Explainability
projects.description: Train a gradient boosting model on customer behaviour data. Apply SHAP for feature importance and individual prediction explanations. Build an interactive Streamlit dashboard that lets stakeholders explore what drives churn.

projects.title: Batch ETL Pipeline with Airflow
projects.description: Build an Apache Airflow DAG that ingests raw CSVs from S3, validates schema with Great Expectations, transforms with dbt, and loads to a Postgres data warehouse. Include SLA alerts and a lineage diagram.

projects.title: Streaming Data Pipeline
projects.description: Implement a Kafka → Spark Structured Streaming → Delta Lake pipeline. Process events in micro-batches, handle late arrivals with watermarks, and write partitioned Parquet to S3. Add a real-time Grafana dashboard.

projects.title: Distributed Task Queue
projects.description: Build a Redis-backed task queue with workers, priority lanes, retry with exponential backoff, and dead-letter queues. Expose a FastAPI management UI. Write load tests with Locust demonstrating throughput.

projects.title: REST API with Full Test Coverage
projects.description: Build a production-quality FastAPI service with Pydantic validation, JWT authentication, PostgreSQL via SQLAlchemy, Alembic migrations, and 90%+ test coverage with pytest. Include GitHub Actions CI that runs tests and linting on every PR.
